name: cairo
title: Cairo · a ZK contract workbench
description: A Cairo/Starknet zero-knowledge contract workbench. Scaffold a Cairo 2 contract, vibecode it with an agent, build it and run its snforge tests — each contract is a self-contained Scarb project mounted as its own submod under orbit/cairo/<name>. Thin orchestration (Python stdlib) over the real toolchain already on this box: scarb 2.8.4, starknet-foundry (snforge/sncast) 0.31, universal-sierra-compiler. The 'vibecode' loop drives the headless Claude CLI, scoped to one submod, to write or edit Cairo and then verifies with build + test.
state: Contracts live in-tree as submods at orbit/cairo/<name>/ (one Scarb project each). No external state dir; scarb target/ and .snfoundry_cache/ are gitignored.

endpoints.POST /cairo/info: What this module is and the routes it serves
endpoints.POST /cairo/list: List contract submods with build/test status
endpoints.POST /cairo/get: One submod: files, Scarb.toml, last build/test (name=)
endpoints.POST /cairo/new: Scaffold a new contract submod (name=, desc=)
endpoints.POST /cairo/vibe: Vibecode a submod with the agent, then build + test (name=, prompt=)
endpoints.POST /cairo/test: snforge test one submod (name=); no name = module self-test
endpoints.POST /cairo/read: Read a file inside a submod (name=, path=)
endpoints.POST /cairo/write: Write a file inside a submod (name=, path=, content=)

safety: vibe() runs the Claude CLI with --permission-mode acceptEdits scoped to a single submod directory (--add-dir), so edits and scarb/snforge runs stay inside that contract's project. It uses the host Claude OAuth credentials and spends against them. No keys are deployed and nothing is sent to a live chain; sncast is present for the user to deploy by hand.
